versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
A troupe of snakes, newts and toads whose deaths are performances: Death Scenes fire on death, Encore units get back up once, and Understudies step into gaps.
Every friendly death adds to a game-long Notices count that pays gold and stats, so other tribes' fodder feeds it too.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Pinned down the unclear rules: Old Crest replays each unit once and isn't doubled, the Prompter's Boy works in the shop and on Understudies, Hesketh says where raised units go, and the Wreath-Bearer's Encore has a duration.
Also gave Little Anguis a 1/1 Tail token and pointed Bit-Part Lizard at the Understudy build.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled the last unclear rules: Old Crest's Death Scene fires once a fight and the Prompter's Boy doubles neither it nor its replays, and Bit-Part Lizard says which unit behind it gets the buff.
Also let Toad Claque cheer Understudies stepping in, gave Anguis's Tail a small Death Scene, and said how Coronella's sales meet the Prompter's Boy.
